legends-dataforseo-kit.purpose: Search and keyword research through DataForSEO.
legends-dataforseo-kit.scope: Python API, CLI and offline research evidence export, verification and reuse checks. Credentials required only for provider requests.

examples: Research keyword demand
Collect search results and preserve reusable evidence
discovery.not_for: Automatic marketing conclusions or a substitute for GeoGrid study design.
discovery.setup: Offline inspection needs no credentials; fresh API work requires credentials and explicit execution authorization.

legends-geogrid.purpose: Google Maps ranking grids and local visibility research.
legends-geogrid.scope: Research-first studies, reports and enhancement. Report libraries included; browser binaries and provider credentials require readiness checks.

examples: Where does my pizza shop appear on Google Maps?
Study local visibility for my business
discovery.not_for: A complete website audit or proof of why Google ranks a business.
discovery.setup: Needs report libraries, map browser and research credentials for fresh studies.

legends-github.purpose: Research search demand and improve repository copy, metadata, presentation, and releases.
legends-github.scope: Headless Python workflows and optional research transport; gh and native skills have separate setup.

examples: Improve discovery of my GitHub project
Optimize my repository with search evidence
discovery.not_for: General website SEO or merely adding unresearched keywords.
discovery.setup: Requires target repository and appropriate GitHub access; live research needs provider credentials.

legends-stable-audio-3.purpose: Create instrumental music, sound effects, and continuous mixes.
legends-stable-audio-3.scope: Managed planning CLI and agent skill. GPU runtime, model access, weights, and hosted credentials are separate setup.

examples: Can we generate some AI music?
Make background music for my video
Create sound effects
discovery.not_for: Speech transcription, voice cloning, or guaranteed vocal songs.
discovery.setup: Lightweight planner install does not install models. Read the audio recipe for model access, hardware and hosted options.

legends-obs-kit.purpose: Inspect, configure, and verify OBS Studio recording workflows, plus an optional cursor overlay extra.
legends-obs-kit.scope: Managed prebuilt Node CLI; Node 22+ required. Live OBS operation targets Windows and needs local OBS WebSocket setup.

examples: Record my screen
Prepare OBS scenes for a tutorial
discovery.not_for: Music generation, transcription or editing a finished video.
discovery.setup: Node.js 22+, Windows OBS and authenticated WebSocket setup; follow module doctor.

legends-hyperyap.purpose: Local voice typing, dictation, and app-focused paste.
legends-hyperyap.scope: Guided native desktop installation. v0.1.0 is source-only; platform installer binaries are pending. Speech model download and microphone/shortcut setup are separate; the manager does not install or track the native app.
legends-hyperyap.next: v0.1.0 ships source only; platform installer binaries are pending. Follow the README for the current install path. Model downloads and native permissions need user setup.

examples: Type with my voice
Dictate into another application
discovery.setup: Native app, microphone permissions and speech models are configured separately.

legends-empire.purpose: Source-cited Empire memory, research evidence, retrieval and recoverable knowledge transactions.
legends-empire.scope: Python 3.11+ standard-library core. Windows supports read-only inspection and previews; canonical vault writes require POSIX/WSL. Obsidian Desktop is optional.

examples: Save this research in my vault
Find what we already know about this business
discovery.not_for: Inventing sources or modifying a vault without selecting it.
discovery.setup: Select a vault. Native Windows supports inspection; transaction writes require POSIX/WSL.

legends-grant.purpose: Find, qualify, and apply for US business grants with agent assistance.
legends-grant.scope: Markdown lanes plus verified federal API routes. The agent drafts and submits once per authorization; the human owns mailed packages and non-delegable logins.

examples: Find grants for my business
Help me apply for a small business grant
discovery.not_for: Automatic approvals or a substitute for reading the live notice terms.
discovery.setup: No credentials for federal search lanes; SAM.gov lanes need a free public API key; submissions need explicit per-send authorization.

legends-firecrawl.purpose: Live web search, scraping, crawling, and offline provider catalog with credit-efficient routing.
legends-firecrawl.scope: Python client plus offline catalog. Vendor CLI and API key need module setup; paid calls need explicit authorization.

examples: Scrape this page to markdown
Search the web for competitors
discovery.not_for: Bypassing authentication, CAPTCHA, robots policy, or access controls; a substitute for vendor billing.
discovery.setup: Needs firecrawl-cli 1.23.3 and FIRECRAWL_API_KEY for live calls; the offline catalog needs neither.

legends-yt-dlp.purpose: Repeatable yt-dlp source pulls, verification, transcripts, search, and clip-building with pacing and bulk guardrails.
legends-yt-dlp.scope: Pip-installed Python CLI in an isolated env. Needs local yt-dlp binary plus ffmpeg for media work; Mullvad VPN is opt-in via --with-vpn.

examples: Rip this video for my edit
Archive this channel with pacing
discovery.not_for: Bypassing DRM, paywalls, logins, captchas, or access controls; rotating relays to push through throttles or blocks.
discovery.setup: Managed yt-dlp binary via legends-yt-dlp yt-dlp install; ffmpeg on PATH for clips; CrispASR external for transcription.

legends-ambient-intelligence.purpose: Passive ambient audio capture, deduplicated archiving, offline transcription, and vault distillation.
legends-ambient-intelligence.scope: Pip-installed Python CLI in an isolated env. Needs ffmpeg plus faster-whisper or NeMo for transcription; USB recorder ingest is Windows-first.

examples: Transcribe my voice memos offline
Ingest recordings from my KT5000
discovery.not_for: Live keyboard dictation (that is legends-hyperyap); cloud transcription endpoints.
discovery.setup: ffmpeg on PATH; pip install .[whisper] for local Whisper; NeMo optional for GPU Parakeet.

legends-captions.purpose: Agentic video caption QA and rendering with contextual correction, alignment timing, and proof evidence.
legends-captions.scope: Pip-installed Python CLI in an isolated env. Pure standard library for policy, manifests, and CLI; Parakeet, NeMo, and renderers are operator-managed externals.

examples: Caption this video with active-word timing
Fix these captions and prove the render
discovery.not_for: Recording audio or running ASR (see legends-ambient-intelligence); generic video editing.
discovery.setup: No services or keys. Optional WSL speech env via LEGENDS_CAPTIONS_WSL_PYTHON for full production runs.
